name: mattermost
description: Community Mattermost REST API v4 client: list teams and channels, read posts, create posts. Not affiliated with Mattermost, Inc.

MATTERMOST_URL.title: Mattermost URL
MATTERMOST_URL.description: Origin only (scheme + host + optional port). No trailing slash or /api path. Example: https://chat.example.com

MATTERMOST_TOKEN.title: Mattermost token
MATTERMOST_TOKEN.description: Bot token or personal access token. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. The plugin does not store this value.
